# Plannix (Your Task Manager)

> Plannix is an intelligent daily task management web application crafted with deadline-aware status tracking, automatic midnight rollover, calendar history, and completion analytics.

## Overview
- Project: Plannix (Your Task Manager)
- Author: Arnab-verse
- Core Stack: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Firebase Firestore & Authentication
- Website: https://plannix.app

## Key Features
- **Smart Deadline Tracking**: Real-time evaluation of task due dates with overdue notifications and priority levels (Critical, High, Medium, Low).
- **Automated Midnight Rollover**: Incomplete tasks automatically roll over to the next day with carry-over counters to prevent forgotten items.
- **Visual Calendar & History**: Full calendar view of historical completion rates, missed tasks, and streaks.
- **Projects & Workspaces**: Categorization of tasks across personal, professional, study, and customized project buckets.
- **Actionable Analytics**: Visualized completion velocity, on-time percentage, and peak productivity windows.
- **Cloud & Offline Sync**: Persistent cloud sync backed by Google Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore with offline fallback.
- **Accessibility & Themes**: WCAG AA compliant contrast, dark/light themes, smooth keyboard navigation, and responsive mobile-first UI.
